item.title: State of Kdenlive
item.description:
📝 Now you can exchange projects with other editing applications that support this open source file format. This change fixes issues with HiDPI displays with fractional scaling. It’s especially useful when working with multiple displays or collaborating with others in the editing room.
🔗 Read more: https://kdenlive.org/news/2026/state-2026/

item.title: Flock Condemns False Child Predator Allegations, Yet Calls Critics Terrorists
item.description:
